lattes2pdf browser build — typst.ts modification notice

The local lattes2pdf web build modifies typst_ts_web_compiler.mjs from
@myriaddreamin/typst-ts-web-compiler 0.7.0 using web/scripts/compiler-csp.ts.

The two wasm-bindgen Function-construction wrappers are replaced with static
JavaScript functions for the known fixed callbacks. Unsupported callback bodies
are rejected. This permits the local runtime to use a CSP without unsafe-eval.
The compiler.wasm binary is not modified by that transform.

Upstream source and license:
https://github.com/Myriad-Dreamin/typst.ts/tree/v0.7.0
See typst-ts-LICENSE.txt for the complete Apache License 2.0 notice.
